Today, Barkman Honey continues to be a beekeeper-owned family business that maintains operations in Artesian, South Dakota, a 60-year tradition that has helped the family grow their honeybee advocacy and preserve bee culture for future generations.

Founded by beekeepers in 1960, Barkman Honey’s beekeeping roots go back to 1920 with great-granddad Esra Barkman learning his trade in the bee yards and buying his first 30 hives. Barkman Honey proudly carries on his legacy from our home base in Kansas, and locations across the nation.
